overview: Distribution Grid Outage Localization addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in power and utilities operations. The first proof of value uses SCADA events, feeder topology and smart meter last-gasp. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is minutes to validated fault section, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: SCADA events, feeder topology and smart meter last-gasp; define minutes to validated fault section and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Grid Operations Director / Chief Asset Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for minutes to validated fault section
